mission: To provide girls in Western Wisconsin with a competitive, development-focused flag football experience that builds skilled players, confident leaders, and strong teammates.
vision: To establish River Falls and Western Wisconsin as a destination for girls’ flag football while creating a sustainable pathway from youth competition through high school and beyond.
standard: Quality experiences over quantity of teams or tournaments. RFGF will only form teams it can support with appropriate roster numbers, qualified coaching, suitable competition, and a high-quality family experience.
why_flag: Girls’ flag football is accessible, fast-paced, and strategic. Every play asks athletes to communicate, read space, make decisions, solve problems together, and contribute on the field.
flag_101: RFGF teams will primarily play 5-on-5 football on a shortened field, replacing tackling with pulling a flag from the ball carrier’s belt. Tournament rules may vary, and coaches will prepare teams for the rules used at each event.
